text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High error rate (5xx) for enterprise tenant `vesta` in us-east-1. Spike started ~2026-02-10T14:23:12Z. Impacting dedicated pool vesta-us-east-1-prod. Paging on-call. https://mon.redwood/alerts/ALRT-3419 :rotating_light:

maya: oncall ash, can you take a look? paging now.

ash: oncall here, looking. initial check: warm pool nodes at 72% CPU, KV cache miss rate up, request queue depth rising on the frontends.

ash: I see a persistent 5xx pattern originating from a subset of instances behind the dedicated pool; suspect a driver/kernel OOM cascade on a few GPUs.

leo: rough customer impact? any data-plane loss or just error spikes?

ash: error rate ~12% for the tenant for the last 6m, some timeouts. API control plane fine. Traffic still flowing but degraded.

priya: I'm on standby to ping Vesta SRE/product. Preparing an incident note for them if we need to shift traffic.

ash: plan proposal: bring up warm capacity in us-west-2 and start a weighted DNS shift via NS1 (because Vesta has peered DNS and low TTL). Gradual 10% steps, monitor 5xx and latency, escalate to full cutover if stable. Rollback plan: revert weights and drain new pool if errors spike.

sam: DNS TTL for vesta is 60s. Weighted CNAME via NS1 is best path. Confirmed route policy in controlplane supports per-tenant weight.

ash: scaling command I'm running now:```bash
# scale warm pool for tenant vesta to 20 nodes in us-west-2
redwoodctl pools scale --tenant vesta --pool warm --region us-west-2 --replicas 20
```

ops-bot: autoscaler: warm pool vesta-us-west-2 resizing 10 -> 20 (initiated by ash). Estimated ready ~3m.

ash: warm pool nodes healthy, KV sync completed. Running initial traffic shift (10%). Command:```bash
redwoodctl traffic shift --tenant vesta --from us-east-1 --to us-west-2 --percent 10 --method dns-weight --provider ns1
```

incident-bot: action logged by ash at 2026-02-10T14:31:02Z.

ash: 10% shift applied. Watching metrics (errors/latency/CPU).

maya: ack, tagging postmortem owner. Priya, can you keep Vesta in the loop and tell them we have a staged plan?

priya: pinged Vesta SRE via #vesta-sre (they're aware and standing by). Drafted a short message to customers if we progress to full cutover.

ash: metrics update (14:36Z): 5xx dropped from 12% -> 8% after 10% shift. Latency stable. Proceeding to another 20% step in 2m if trend holds.

sam: confirming DNS provider update history: NS1 supports weighted change history; I can watch and revert weights if needed.

ash: applying next step to 30% total.```bash
redwoodctl traffic shift --tenant vesta --from us-east-1 --to us-west-2 --percent 30 --method dns-weight --provider ns1
```

ops-bot: change accepted by control plane. New weights pushed to NS1.

ash: after 30% step (14:42Z): 5xx down to 4.5%, CPU on us-east instances dropping. No new alarms.

leo: customer SLA windows? do we need exec notif?

maya: not yet, Leo. Priya has comms queued if we do full cutover. Severity still P2 until we stabilize.

priya: Vesta says they prefer us-west failover if stable. They're ok with staged DNS cutover. Also asked for ETA to full shift.

ash: ETA to full shift (100%) ~25-40m depending on stability. Rollback immediate if 5xx spikes >8% for two consecutive intervals.

ash: continuing to 60% now.```bash
redwoodctl traffic shift --tenant vesta --from us-east-1 --to us-west-2 --percent 60 --method dns-weight --provider ns1
```

incident-bot: note: DNS TTL 60s, expected propagation within ~2m per step.

ash: after 60% (14:58Z): error rate ~1.2%, us-east CPU moderate but healthy, warm pool carrying load. Proceeding to 100% by end of window.

ash: final step to 100% executed. NS1 weights set: us-west-2 100%, us-east-1 0%. Route test passed. Verified by curl to vesta endpoints from three regions.

ops-bot: background: created rollback job (id rollback-3419009999) ready to run if needed.

priya: Vesta confirmed receiving traffic and reports normal responses. They've thanked us and asked for a short post-incident note.

maya: great. We'll keep the warm pool up for 2h and then scale down to baseline. Priya will own customer comms. Ash to own postmortem/action items.

ash: adding action items: 1) investigate root cause on us-east nodes (OOM logs + driver crash dump), 2) improve autoscaling thresholds for this tenant, 3) add runbook step for NS1-weighted cutover.

leo: thanks team. Marking incident as mitigated.

maya: incident severity downgraded. Closing active paging. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: incident-3419009999 marked mitigated at 2026-02-10T15:10:05Z.

ash: will follow up with postmortem in #postmortems and link the kernel/driver dumps.

priya: sending customer note now.

maya: ending thread, thanks everyone.
